description: Source code for DeviceIdentityStore class managing device identities, including generation, loading, signing, and verification, with persistent storage and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: Data class representing a device's identity, including device ID, public and private keys, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: Class responsible for managing device identities, including creation, loading, signing, and verification of payloads.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists, updating the cache.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a given payload string using the device's private key.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature against a payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the URL-safe Base64 representation of the device's public key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from storage.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads and parses a device identity from a file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the device identity to persistent storage.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with cryptographic keys and device ID.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives device ID from public key bytes using SHA-256.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of data and returns as hexadecimal string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes byte array into URL-safe Base64 string.
